contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The desk's deterministic channels are clustering around AI-infrastructure and semiconductor capital-equipment names, with the tightest convergence in NVDA (5 channels + Pelosi stake + Cramer chatter) and PLTR (gov-contract acceleration + Trump-linked, though the trump_side flag reads 'sell'). Track record is empty, so every read here is uncalibrated and must stay modest.

signals.thesis: NVDA shows the deepest multi-channel convergence: it ties together analyst upgrades, patent activity, retail buzz (WSB mentions 207), and special-situation context. Nancy Pelosi holds a disclosed stake, alongside Marjorie Taylor Greene and Michael McCaul, and Paul Pelosi is affiliated through the paired relationship. Jensen Huang directly controls. Jim Cramer's chatter is priced as a purely inverse/qualitative signal, but it confirms the name is in motion. What keeps me cautious: rs_vs_spy_60d is only +6.1, so the stock has NOT run away from the market, which is why ACCUMULATE is defensible here. The second-order read is that GPU accumulation implies memory (MU), semicap equipment (AMAT, INTC), and AI datacenter power/infrastructure (HUT via the label-mismatch repoint).

signals.thesis: PLTR has the strongest government-contract acceleration in the pack (gov_contract_accel 1.76), a Trump-linked flag, and substantial analytic convergence. But the trump_side reads 'sell,' not 'buy' — this is a direct contradiction with the retail-bull signal. MTG's disclosed stake plus Cathie Wood's AFFILIATES_WITH link only compound the noise. rs_vs_spy_60d is +25.8, and while the pack does not flag it as extended (below +35), the run has already been substantial. The right entry posture is WATCH: let either the contract acceleration show up in next earnings, or wait for a 60d relative-strength mean reversion to take advantage. Second-order beneficiaries are government-IT peers (BA via Cramer's endorsement and gov_grant, MSFT via Altman partnership, and the broader defense software complex).
